bug_summary: 未移植パス(seam-missやpanic!)がbackend全体を巻き込むabortとなっていたのを、main_loopをcatch_unwindで包み込み構造化されたSQL ERRORへ変換するよう修正。
pr_title: Simplify panic classification in the ereport hook
pr_description: The panic hook now matches payloads against the PGRUST-SQLSTATE: prefix directly instead of treating any string/&str payload as a handled ereport. This also removes the catch_unwind wrapper around each main-loop iteration, since the prefix check gives the hook enough information on its own to stay quiet for handled cases.
